# Goally

> > Goally is a safe tablet and app platform for kids with neurodiverse needs, featuring the Daily Skills System with visual schedules, emotional regulation, and behavior tracking tools.

Goally provides specialized tablets and therapeutic apps designed for children with autism, ADHD, and other developmental needs. The platform combines hardware, software, and parent/clinician tools to support daily routines, emotional regulation, life skills development, and speech therapy.

## Key Topics

- Daily Skills System
- CoPilot (visual schedules)
- Mood Tuner (emotional regulation)
- Goal Mine (life skills training)
- Word Lab (AAC/speech therapy)
- Rewards (behavior tracking)
- Parent App
- Special education
- ABA therapy
- Executive functioning
- Meltdown management
- Independence building
- Goally Tablet
- Speech-generating device (SGD-3)
- Medicaid funding

## Core Products & Features

- [The Best Tablet for Kids | Goally](https://getgoally.com): Goally homepage showcasing safe tablet for kids with Daily Skills System and Parent App
- [Best Learning Apps for Kids | Goally](https://getgoally.com/goally-therapy-suite): Goally therapy suite with CoPilot, Mood Tuner, Goal Mine for routines and life skills
- [Visual Schedule App | CoPilot - Goally Apps & Tablets for Kids](https://getgoally.com/goally-apps/visual-schedule-app): CoPilot visual schedule app for customizing routines with videos and photos
- [Emotional Regulation App | Mood Tuner - Goally Apps & Tablets for Kids](https://getgoally.com/goally-apps/emotional-regulation-app-mood-tuner): Mood Tuner emotional regulation app for identifying emotions and preventing meltdowns
- [Reward Chart for Kids | Rewards - Goally Apps & Tablets for Kids](https://getgoally.com/goally-apps/reward-chart-app-for-kids): Rewards app for digital reward charts and point systems with motivation

## Clinical & Educational Solutions

- [Apps for Special Education | Goally](https://getgoally.com/clinicians-teachers/goallys-apps-for-teachers): Special education apps including Word Lab and Routine App for teachers and therapists
- [Speech Therapy Apps - Goally](https://getgoally.com/clinicians-teachers/speech-therapy): Speech therapy apps with Word Lab AAC device for language development
- [Occupational Therapy Apps | Goally](https://getgoally.com/clinicians-teachers/occupational-therapy): Occupational therapy apps with Goal Mine for ADL training and motor skills
- [Apps for ABA Therapy](https://getgoally.com/clinicians-teachers/behavior-therapy): ABA therapy apps for BCBA and RBT with behavior tracking and parent carryover
